mapper.select: WITH user_interactions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END AS user_id, MAX(CREATE_TIME) AS last_message_time FROM im_message WHERE (FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} OR TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) AND CHAT_TYPE = 1 AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END ), unread_messages AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM im_message WHERE (TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) AND CHAT_TYPE = 1 AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND IS_READ = 2 GROUP BY CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END ) SELECT ui.user_id, m.CONTENT, m.TYPE, m.CREATE_TIME, COALESCE(um.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM user_interactions ui JOIN im_message m ON ( (m.FROM_USER_ID = ui.user_id AND m.TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) OR (m.FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} AND m.TO_USER_ID = ui.user_id) ) LEFT JOIN unread_messages um ON ui.user_id = um.user_id WHERE m.CREATE_TIME = ui.last_message_time AND m.CHAT_TYPE = '1' AND m.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ORDER BY m.CREATE_TIME DESC
